teaser: A proposed encrypted messenger between vaults: append lanes for transport, PKI for trust, and Messaging-FS as the schema.
core_idea: Append lanes on every user's vault, combined with PKI, give an end-to-end encrypted messaging system between vaults, used from the web or the command line; Messaging-FS adds the schema, one JSON file per conversation beside Email-FS's one file per email, with each side writing only its own vault so there are no conflicts.
